To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
a single-stage single-switch PFC converter using a SR with the variable switching-frequency controller is proposed to achieve the high power factor and the efficiency.
a new driving circuit of the synchronous rectifier (DRSR) is proposed and a single-stage single-switch PFC flyback converter with DRSR and a variable switching-frequency (VSW) controller is proposed.

the proposed single-stage single-switch PFC flyback converter using a synchronous rectifier is continuously operated with reduced turn-on switching losses at the boundary between continuous conduction mode (CCM) and discontinuous condition mode (DCM) and the proposed PFC circuit with SR driving circuit in flyback converter with reduced switching loss is analyzed in detail and the performance of the circuit is verified through experimental results.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the development of a single-stage PFC converter using a SR for the next generation of high-performance power supplies.
a single-stage single-switch PFC flyback converter using a synchronous rectifier.
the development of a single-stage single-switch PFC flyback converter with high power factor and efficiency for the universal line voltage.

the proposed converter is suitable for the high-efficiency, low-cost, and universal input voltage applications.
the proposed converter has the following advantages: (a) a high power factor, (b) a low dc-link voltage and (c) high efficiency.
the proposed converter has a high power factor, low input current total harmonic distortion, and low dc-link voltage, which is suitable for universal-line applications.

the proposed PFC converter has the advantages of low dc-link voltage, low input ripple current, low switching loss, and high efficiency.
the proposed converter can achieve the high efficiency and high power factor in wide input-voltage ranges.
the proposed PFC flyback converter can be used for the universal line voltage with a high efficiency and power factor.

the proposed PFC converter with a SR driving circuit has high power efficiency of 94.5% at 230 V and 90% at 100 V.
the proposed converter has a high power factor, low dc-link voltage, and high efficiency, and can be used as a universal input adapter.
a single-stage single-switch PFC flyback converter with an SR can provide a relatively low dc-link output voltage in the universal input voltage range, high power factor, and high efficiency.
